title: Amy Bruni brings 'Walking With Ghosts: Real Life Hauntings' to the Egyptian Theatre Oct. 7
excerpt: Best known for her work on paranormal television, including “Ghost Hunters” and “Kindred Spirits,” Bruni has spent years investigating some of the country’s most haunted locations.
content:
Paranormal investigator, author and television personality Amy Bruni brings an evening of true ghost stories to the Egyptian Theatre in downtown DeKalb with “Walking With Ghosts: Real Life Hauntings” Wednesday, Oct. 7 at 7:30 p.m.

Best known for her work on paranormal television, including “Ghost Hunters” and “Kindred Spirits,” Bruni has spent years investigating some of the country’s most haunted locations and exploring the stories of those who may still linger behind, according to a news release.

In “Walking With Ghosts”, Bruni takes audiences beyond the television screen to share firsthand accounts from her paranormal investigations, including some of the most memorable, unsettling and unexpected experiences from her career.

Blending storytelling, history and the paranormal, the live show offers audiences a closer look at Bruni’s approach to investigating hauntings and the real people and stories behind them.

The evening is a fitting addition to spooky season at the historic Egyptian Theatre, a nearly century-old venue with plenty of unexplained stories of its own.

Tickets can be purchased at the Egyptian Theatre box office during box office hours (Tuesday/Wednesday/Thursday 3-6 p.m.), online at egyptiantheatre.org or by calling the box office at 815-758-1225.

The Egyptian Theatre located at 135 N. 2nd St. in downtown DeKalb.
